STEP 11. Check the 5-volt supply circuit voltage at ECM 
connector C-58 <M/T> or PCM connector C-55 <A/T>.
(1) Do not disconnect ECM connector C-58 <M/T> or PCM 
connector C-55 <A/T>.
(2) Turn the ignition switch to the "ON" position.
(3) Measure the voltage between terminal 42 <M/T> or terminal 
46 <A/T> and ground by backprobing.
• Voltage should be between 4.8 and 5.2 volts.
(4) Turn the ignition switch to the "LOCK" (OFF) position.
Q: Is the multi-meter reading within the specified value?
YES : Check connectors D-16, C-90, C-28, C-58 <M/T> or 
C-55 <A/T> and repair or replace as required. Refer 
to GROUP00E, Harness Connector Inspection 
P.00E-2. If connectors D-16, C-90, C-28, C-58 <M/T> 
or C-55 <A/T> are in good condition, check the 
harness between intermediate connector D-16 and 
ECM connector C-58 <M/T> or PCM connector C-55 
<A/T> for open circuit or damage. Then repair if 
necessary. Then go to Step 26.
NO : Go to Step 12.
STEP 12. Check ECM connector C-58 <M/T> or PCM 
connector C-55 <A/T> for damage.
(1) Disconnect ECM connector C-58 <M/T> or PCM connector 
C-55 <A/T>.
Q: Is there any failure at ECM connector C-58 <M/T> or 
PCM connector C-55 <A/T>?
YES : Repair or replace it. Refer to GROUP 00E, Harness 
Connector Inspection P.00E-2. Then go to Step 26.
NO : Go to Step 13.
STEP 13. Check the sensor power supply line for short 
circuit to ground at ECM connector C-58 <M/T> or PCM 
connector C-55 <A/T>.
(1) Disconnect ECM connector C-58 <M/T> or PCM connector 
C-55 <A/T> and measure at the harness side.
(2) Check for the continuity between terminal 42 <M/T> or 
terminal 46 <A/T> and ground.
• There should be 2 ohms or more.
Q: Does the multi-meter reading exceed the specified 
value?
YES : Replace ECM or PCM. Then go to Step 26.
NO : Go to Step 14.
